methods.bootstrap: Resample sorted item IDs with replacement within each sample/tier/reader, retain every observed output of each drawn item (all4generations inQ1, selected doses together inQ2b). Same default_rng(seed) item-index draws for every rate within a group; restart seed per group. Ratio of pooled numerator/denominator counts. Equal-tailed percentile95%. Undefined denominator draws omitted from quantiles and counted; zero defined draws→unavailable.
methods.rate_scope: All rate leaves of the original tier-reader summaries, including mode, mention kinds, conditional accuracies, enactment, Q1hallucination/extra and applicableQ2extras. Original Wilson intervals/points retained.
methods.mention_kind_accuracy: quotes_token/states_property separately; correct/allkind mentions includes unclear as unresolved; correct/resolved usesA/B only. Both Wilson and cluster95%.
methods.asked_free_rule: Q1only, original sealed gallery ALL60_RANKING percentiles. Asked high=pct>=0.5. Oracle free success=3or4of4enacts with correct codedA/B; NLA=3or4of4mentions with correct codedA/B. Nonmention/nonenact/unclear count as not correct; 2of4 is not a majority (tie reported separately). All20items/tier/reader; list IDs for both discordance directions. High percentile is not itself an asked-answer correctness claim.
methods.rater2_policy: Require code/input hash seal before per-fieldkappa; do not use unsealed JSONLs. Do not wait.
methods.q2d_policy: No finished sample/codes currently in sharedcache; NOTDONECURRENTLY. DeadlineSunday2026-10-25T23:59:00+01:00(CET), no automatic wakeup/codingcall/API/GPU. Report any delivered completed artifact separately.

rater2.provenance_limitation: Producer seal binds code hashes but omits input hashes; local verification supplements with canonical sealed input hashes, complete unique ID coverage and exact per-ID evidence checks. No new annotation or repair.

sign_followup.rule: Asked favours true value iff original truth-signed mean paired logodds s>0; s=0 grouped nonpositive and counted separately. Same original free majority>=3/4: Oracle enact/NLA mention; unclear or absent not correct. Percentile split retained separately and never treated as sign/asked correctness.
